title: [GMCP 203.005.06] Operations and evidence: Production-grade stdio transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-005-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes MCP over stdio with byte-accurate framing, bounded lines/messages, strict stdout protocol purity, stderr diagnostics, environment and working-directory control, graceful cancellation and shutdown, child-tree cleanup, backpressure, timeout handling, and Windows/Unix parity. Crash, hang, malformed output, descriptor leak, and hostile child fixtures all recover without stranding resources. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
